<!-- name: Audit Recovery -->
<!-- board: Audit recovery is complete | Release publishing is gated | 3.2 and T-Watch stay in CI -->
**Audit Recovery.** This release reconciles the fork with the current upstream T-Watch work, repairs the build/publish pipeline, and hardens the storage, concurrency, and update paths found during the full-project audit.

**Fixed**
- Restored the Theme title-bar helper required by the T-Watch build.
- Brought the latest upstream T-Watch screen-timeout and automatic clock-setting behavior into the fork without removing the 3.2-inch CYD work.
- Fixed the SD security wipe so it removes every SquachWatch log, not only the first sixteen.
- Changed SD log filenames to real local calendar dates when trusted time is available, with an honest uptime fallback before the clock is known.
- Hardened the OTA mutex path against allocation failure and moved this fork's Wi-Fi OTA endpoint to its own Pages site over HTTPS.
- Fixed the boot-time update check to use TLS with the HTTPS Pages endpoint instead of constructing a plain TCP client for an HTTPS URL.
- Changed the physical NVS wipe from a secret denylist to a safe-preserve allowlist. Encounter/history namespaces such as regulars, dex, squachwatch, and bingo, plus credentials/security state, are no longer restored after a duress/security wipe.
- Made Bingo's cross-task pending bitmap atomic with a critical section and moved DEX/Regulars state mutation out of radio callback context into loop-side pending handoff.
- Removed the duplicate Regulars sighting call and duplicate ignore-list include.
- Repaired the lab-tag version path so lab-* builds bypass real-release VERSION/tag equality checks.
- Development firmware now identifies as `1.20.1-dev+<sha>`; only the exact v1.20.1 release identifies as `1.20.1`. The OTA comparator treats a clean release as newer than a same-version development build.
- Repaired Pages/release handoff, rollback retention, exact emulator builds, shared ESP32 artifact verification, and board-matrix coverage.
- Production Pages no longer publishes from ordinary master builds. It deploys only the exact validated `pages-site` artifact from the release/lab workflow.
- Release publication now happens last: firmware, signatures, manifests, emulator, Pages site, and final artifact validation must succeed before a real GitHub Release is exposed.
- Real release builds now require `OTA_SIGNING_KEY` and verify that it matches the public key compiled into `include/ota_pubkey.h`; lab builds may remain USB-only when the secret is absent.
- Removed the known-boot-looping 3.5-inch profile from public release/picker paths while leaving its development environment in the source tree.
- Updated fork-facing README/FAQ links to the fork's GitHub Pages site and corrected stale HTTP/overclock comments.

**Changed**
- Public/release firmware profiles are required to compile in CI, including the 3.2-inch 80 MHz build.
- LilyGo T-Watch S3 is a public beta profile.
- PlatformIO library versions and the XPT2046 source commit are pinned.
- The browser flasher pins ESP Web Tools 10.4.0 and esptool-js 0.6.1. They remain CDN-hosted for this release; the README documents that residual dependency rather than swapping in an unreviewed local bundle.
- Official GitHub Actions were moved to current Node 24-era major versions where compatible; the Emscripten compiler remains deliberately pinned to 6.0.9.
- The public Windows 3.2-inch flash helper no longer assumes COM17.

**Release gate**
- v1.20.1 must not be tagged/published until the repository Actions secret `OTA_SIGNING_KEY` is configured with the private key corresponding to the public key already compiled into the firmware.
- Master branch protection is a repository setting and must be enabled separately; it is not represented as a source-code change.
